description: operation_mode=ComfortableDehumidification (Dry) rejected 3 times (temp=24 -> E-21291-01712; temp=0 -> E-21291-00007; temp=0 + ai_control=off -> E-21291-00007 again) before Kevin's insight: this mode needs `humidity` included in the PUT body, which the general contract (CONTROL_REQUEST_FIELDS) deliberately excludes for every other mode. First success: temperature=0.0 + humidity=50.
app_confirmed: App shows Dry mode active with a 50% humidity target.
notes: MAJOR FINDING: humidity, which the general control-request contract deliberately excludes (see findings.md's 'RESOLVED' section), is actually REQUIRED for this one mode. Without it, every attempt failed regardless of temperature or ai_control value.

temperature=0.0 is correct for this mode -- it targets humidity, not temperature. temperature=24.0 (a real value) was rejected with E-21291-01712 (temperature-out-of-range), confirming this mode genuinely has no temperature target.
humidity has no GET readback, same as silence_control -- confirmed by checking the response body, which has no humidity field at all.
The response also doesn't echo the humidity value in any form -- can't verify what value 'stuck' from the response alone, only via the app.
See 20-24 for the humidity range investigation that followed.
